verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for self-hosted IAM software, but the evidence pack never documents vendor telemetry, usage tracking, or any control to disable them. The metrics and OpenTelemetry guides describe operator-side observability, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
